caption: your feet are slowing you down #boxing #footwork #boxingtips #jumprope #boxingtraining

slides.needs: boxer feet on ring canvas, low angle, ring lights
slides.text: Here's exactly why your footwork feels slow...
You're flat-footed. Stay on the balls of your feet with a light bounce.
Your stance is too wide. Wide is stable, but slow to move.
You move the wrong foot first. Going forward, front foot leads. Going back, back foot leads.

slides.needs: jump rope in dark gym, single light
slides.text: You skip rope like it's cardio. Use it for rhythm: switch feet, change speed.
